races.paceDynamic: Lucky Vick appears the lone confirmed front-runner in this weak maiden hurdle, with Luker's Tipple and Game Point likely to sit prominent behind him. With no genuine speed in the field and Lucky Vick making his hurdling debut, the pace will be pedestrian through the early stages before quickening from the second-last. The lack of pace pressure should create a tactical affair where horses with experience and tactical speed can overcome positioning. This race shape clearly favours prominent racers and those with a turn of foot who can strike late from midfield positions.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Experienced Class Tells
scenarios.trigger: If Luker's Tipple or Game Point travel smoothly into contention
scenarios.body: The superior class and racecourse experience of these two will prove decisive in a slowly-run race where ability matters more than position. Their handlers know how to win these tactical affairs when pace is lacking.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Specialists Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly crawling and it becomes a sprint finish
scenarios.body: Late-running horses like Lureka Du Noyer and Euro Agent can utilise their stamina and patience to outfinish tired leaders. The tactical nature allows patient rides to pay dividends when others have shot their bolt too early.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Steals It
scenarios.trigger: If Lucky Vick gets an uncontested lead and jumps fluently
scenarios.body: With no serious pace pressure, Lucky Vick could dictate terms and prove hard to catch despite his inexperience over hurdles. His bumper form suggests enough ability to take advantage of a weak field if left alone in front.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Maiden Surprise Package
scenarios.trigger: If one of the newcomers shows unexpected improvement and jumping ability
scenarios.body: Horses like Tellyouwhat or Drumadeise could spring a surprise if they possess more ability than their connections have revealed. Weak maidens often throw up shock results when the favourite fails to fire.

watchPoints.text: Lucky Vick could steal this if allowed an uncontested lead, watch for him dictating terms from the front
Luker's Tipple's jumping and fitness after 159-day break, any market confidence would be significant
Game Point's attitude problems from Flat racing, needs to show the same willing attitude as his Sligo debut
Any late money for the newcomers Tellyouwhat or Drumadeise, particularly with their breeding backgrounds
Lureka Du Noyer's jumping fluency after long break, his French experience could prove decisive in weak race

races.paceDynamic: Doesthatmakesense will likely lead from the start with no obvious speed to pressure her, allowing for a controlled gallop through the early and middle stages. La Cote Fleurie and Aruntothequeen are the main prominent racers who will track just behind, with the majority of this 16-runner field settling in midfield and rear positions. The pace will be genuine but not overly strong until the final half-mile when the holds-up horses begin their move. This pace shape strongly favours prominent racers and early positioned horses who can avoid the inevitable traffic problems that will emerge from the large field of mainly hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Doesthatmakesense maintains a steady pace without weakening dramatically
scenarios.body: The early-positioned horses will have first run on the field and avoid the congestion behind, with La Cote Fleurie and Aruntothequeen ideally placed to strike. The hold-up brigade will struggle to find racing room and clear passages in time.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Finds Gap
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses significantly or traffic clears for one of the back markers
scenarios.body: A well-ridden hold-up horse will benefit from the strong pace and time their run to perfection through a gap that opens. Ardeen Joy or Carleys Lilly could emerge late if connections judge the pace correctly.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Benefits All
scenarios.trigger: If Doesthatmakesense stops quickly and no sustained pace develops
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where the best horse on the day wins regardless of tactics. This levels the playing field and allows any horse with ability to win, including the newcomers.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Progression Story
scenarios.trigger: If one of the previous poor performers has improved significantly for new connections or schooling
scenarios.body: The race becomes about hidden improvement rather than tactical positioning. Horses like Eyecanboogie or Knockarina returning from breaks could surprise if they've turned the corner.

watchPoints.text: Doesthatmakesense may not sustain the gallop based on her fading pattern, potentially leaving no pace
Traffic problems will be severe with 13+ hold-up horses requiring late gaps in a 16-runner field
Market support for newcomers Becca Sommers and Humble Berkshire will indicate their readiness
La Cote Fleurie's jumping on hurdles debut will determine if she can utilize her tactical advantage
Ardeen Joy returning after 53-day break could be primed for improvement with Elliott's excellent strike-rate

races.paceDynamic: Ixigreczed stands alone as the confirmed front-runner and will face no early pressure from this field of predominantly hold-up horses. With 14 hold-up runners, 3 prominent types, and only She'll Be Kept offering potential early company, Ixigreczed can dictate terms unchallenged through steady fractions. The lack of pace pressure means the leader can conserve energy for the finish while the massive hold-up contingent gets strung out behind, creating a traffic nightmare in the straight. This race shape heavily favours front-runners and prominent racers who can avoid the scramble, while hold-up horses face an uphill battle in a slowly-run affair.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Ixigreczed gets an easy lead and maintains rhythm
scenarios.body: The lack of pace pressure allows the leader to control the race completely, with hold-up horses unable to close the gap effectively in a slowly-run contest. Prominent racers get first run on the tiring leader while the majority struggle for racing room.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Racers Strike
scenarios.trigger: If She'll Be Kept or Amburana track the leader closely and time their move perfectly
scenarios.body: The few prominent runners can position ideally behind the uncontested leader before delivering their challenge with tactical advantage. Hold-up horses remain disadvantaged by the lack of pace and crowded finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Finds Gap
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and a strong finisher gets a clear run
scenarios.body: A truly-run race allows one of the better hold-up types to overcome the tactical disadvantage through superior class or fitness. Traffic problems still eliminate most backmarkers from contention.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Duel Develops
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses challenge Ixigreczed early creating faster fractions

races.paceDynamic: Not So Serious is the only confirmed front runner in this 19-runner field and will get an easy lead with no pace pressure. The majority of the field are hold-up horses who will need to make their moves from the back as the pace quickens after the last hurdle. With such a weak early pace and a 2m4f trip that allows plenty of time for positioning, this becomes a tactical affair decided by who can produce the strongest finishing kick. This race shape clearly favours hold-up horses and those with proven finishing speed over the stamina-sapping distance.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Tactical Hold-Up Battle
scenarios.trigger: If Not So Serious sets slow fractions and the field bunches up approaching the straight
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where horses with recent form and proven acceleration dominate over those returning from layoffs. Recent winners and placed horses like Marian Avenue and Hob's Angel can strike from their hold-up positions.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Early Leader Folds
scenarios.trigger: If Not So Serious gets headed early or fades turning for home under pressure
scenarios.body: This opens up the race for prominent runners like Hidalgo Des Mottes to inherit a good position while hold-up horses struggle for room in the pack. The lack of genuine pace still favours those who can position closer to the action.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Slow Pace Suits Outsiders
scenarios.trigger: If the crawling pace allows weak form horses to stay competitive deep into the race
scenarios.body: Horses with stamina concerns or poor recent form get a lifeline when the race lacks a proper gallop until very late. Long-priced runners with some historical ability can emerge from the pack.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Not So Serious maintains his lead and the field fails to organise a strong challenge
scenarios.body: The lack of pace pressure throughout allows the leader to dictate completely and kick clear when others are still organising their runs. This unlikely scenario requires the field to be particularly passive.

watchPoints.text: Not So Serious must be monitored for how easily he leads as the only pace angle - any pressure early could see him fold quickly

Monitor Hob's Angel for signs of vulnerability carrying 6lb more after her breakthrough win two weeks ago

races.paceDynamic: Marlpark is the sole confirmed front runner and will set the early tempo uncontested, likely creating a sustainable gallop rather than a fierce pace. The prominent runners Minella Diamond and Swelltime will track the leader, with the bulk of the field sitting further back in hold-up positions including Chemdawg, Cocovic, and Committee Meeting. With limited early pace pressure on Marlpark, this should develop into a genuine staying test where horses need to travel strongly and finish resolutely over the final 3-4 furlongs. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce sustained finishing efforts, as the moderate early pace will leave plenty in reserve for a competitive finish.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Marlpark sets an uncontested moderate pace as expected
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure creates ideal conditions for the numerous hold-up horses to close strongly, with fresh finishers sweeping past tired leaders. Chemdawg and Cocovic are perfectly positioned to exploit this scenario with their proven ability to finish fast from the rear.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the moderate pace becomes a sprint finish where position matters
scenarios.body: Minella Diamond or another prominent runner benefits from being close enough to kick when it matters but not having done the donkey work up front. The winner comes from those tracking Marlpark within 3-4 lengths throughout.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Stays Strong
scenarios.trigger: If Marlpark's soft lead allows him to conserve energy for a strong finish
scenarios.body: The lack of pressure enables the leader to dictate terms completely and prove hard to pass when the field comes to challenge. Marlpark uses his fitness advantage and tactical position to hold off late challengers.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos Finish Benefits Outsider
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely creating a messy sprint where luck matters
scenarios.body: The moderate gallop leaves multiple horses with chances turning for home, creating traffic problems and favoring those with clear runs. An unfancied runner like Another Glendaars or Committee Meeting profits from the confusion.

races.paceDynamic: Jack Inthe Jukebox is the only confirmed front runner in this field of 15, giving him an uncontested lead in the early stages. With most runners adopting hold-up tactics and only Navy Waves and Sineads Fancy likely to race prominently, the pace will be modest through the first circuit. The lack of pace pressure will allow Jack Inthe Jukebox to dictate terms, but his tendency to fade in the finish creates opportunities for the strong contingent of hold-up horses to close late. This race shape strongly favours patient, staying types who can finish strongly up Limerick's testing hill.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Patient Closers Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Jack Inthe Jukebox sets a steady pace without early pressure
scenarios.body: The moderate gallop plays perfectly into the hands of the hold-up brigade who can unleash late kicks. Cozone, Western Model, and Barryroe Madam all possess the class and stamina to capitalise on this tactical setup.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Horses Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Navy Waves and Sineads Fancy press Jack Inthe Jukebox earlier than expected
scenarios.body: The increased tempo stretches the field and favours horses racing closer to the pace who avoid traffic problems. Navy Waves' proven hill-climbing ability and Sineads Fancy's course-and-distance experience become crucial advantages.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Benefits
scenarios.trigger: If Jack Inthe Jukebox completely fades turning in after setting crawling fractions
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where tactical position matters more than stamina, suiting horses with turn of foot. Moonshine Girl and Thats All can benefit from being closer to the pace when it matters.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Shock
scenarios.trigger: If Jack Inthe Jukebox's new headgear combination transforms his finishing effort
scenarios.body: He maintains his uncontested lead and kicks clear when the closers are still winding up. The lack of early pace pressure combined with improved resolution creates a surprise wire-to-wire victory.

watchPoints.text: Jack Inthe Jukebox could steal this if his new tongue-tie and cheekpieces combination prevents his usual fade
Navy Waves listed as non-runner but any late market moves suggest possible declarations
Cozone and Western Model both returning from breaks but their class edge could prove decisive
The large field of 15 could cause traffic problems for hold-up horses if the pace is too slow
Embrace The Day, Lady Aquarelle and Barrowline all show fading tendencies that make them risky propositions

runners_data.spotlight: Best effort in maidens came at Tramore when she finished 8l fourth (2m5f, good) last August; mistake three out costly when well beaten at Listowel on handicap debut; will enjoy the ground; player on return from 243-day absence.

runners_data.name: Craic Eile
runners_data.note: Experienced prominent runner carrying just 148lbs but hasn't won since 2021 despite recent Wexford run
runners_data.comment: Both hurdle wins came at Tramore but nothing since 2021; modest fifth at Wexford on return
runners_data.spotlight: Both hurdle wins came at Tramore but nothing since 2021; out of form last summer; modest fifth at Wexford on return.

runners_data.name: Je Suis
runners_data.note: Only confirmed front runner who disappointed as well-backed favourite on previous course appearance
runners_data.comment: Disappointed when sent off the well-backed fav' for Killarney handicap chase in October
runners_data.spotlight: Yet to make an impact in ten hurdle/chase starts although best hurdles effort was at this course in April last year; disappointed when sent off the well-backed favourite for Killarney handicap chase in October; 235 days off.

runners_data.name: Anysignofhim
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse suited by good ground who faces more realistic task after tough Clonmel assignment
runners_data.comment: Stiff task in claiming hurdle at Clonmel last time; this a more realistic opportunity
runners_data.spotlight: Maiden from 11 starts over hurdles; set a stiff task in claiming hurdle at Clonmel last time; this a more realistic opportunity; enjoys good ground.

runners_data.name: Island McCoo
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with tongue-tie fitted, rated 4lb lower over hurdles than chasing mark
runners_data.comment: Stayed on well at Sligo; the step up in trip and this track may suit his running style
runners_data.spotlight: Chase winner is rated 4lb lower in this sphere; best handicap hurdle effort yet on latest at Sligo (2m4f, good) when never-nearer fourth of 16 (Love Like This second); the step up in trip on a more galloping track should suit.

runners_data.name: Love Like This
runners_data.note: Consistent hold-up performer who stayed on strongly for recent Sligo second to Island McCoo
runners_data.comment: Good claims on her Sligo second but she's still a maiden after 42 starts; hard to trust
runners_data.spotlight: Still a maiden after 42 starts but solid effort over hurdles at Sligo (2m4f, good) on penultimate when staying on dourly to take second (Island McCoo back in fourth); ran no race here over fences last week; hard to trust.

runners_data.name: Mickey Hulie
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with dual point wins whose best effort was narrow Naas defeat over 3m trip
runners_data.comment: Dual point winner is yet to score from nine runs under rules; claims on his Naas run
runners_data.spotlight: Dual point winner is yet to score from nine runs under rules; claims on the basis of his neck runner-up finish at Naas (3m, soft to heavy); below that level when favourite here eight days later; disappointed in cheekpieces (left off) at Kilbeggan; solid chance if he handles the ground.

runners_data.name: Queen Kulina
runners_data.note: Hold-up veteran wearing cheekpieces who ran creditable fourth at Galway off higher mark
runners_data.comment: Has form at 3m but recent Punchestown fall (behind Oogum Boogum) not encouraging; reserve
runners_data.spotlight: Maiden ran some good races in defeat after a lengthy absence last season, the standout when beaten 1.5l into fourth at Galway (3m, yielding) off 1lb higher in October; was still travelling okay when a faller four out on 3m Punchestown return 15 days ago.

runners_data.name: Something Simple
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who pulled up in first two handicap attempts and lacks competitive form
runners_data.comment: Pulled up in opening 2 handicap runs and well beaten lto at Clonmel; others preferred
runners_data.spotlight: Pulled up in opening two handicap runs and well beaten last time at Clonmel; others preferred.

runners_data.name: Head For Home
runners_data.note: Prominent runner wearing cheekpieces with pattern of fading in finish, best effort at Punchestown
runners_data.comment: Improved fourth of 21 at Cork (24.5f, good) this month when making good headway from rear
runners_data.spotlight: Standout effort a 4.75l second of 20 at Punchestown last October off 80 (2m4f, good to yielding); pulled up on return at Down Royal but much-improved fourth of 21 at Cork (24.5f, good) this month when making good headway from rear; shortlisted.

races.paceDynamic: Je Suis will be the only confirmed front runner, setting a sustainable pace without early pressure from the 14-runner field. Poetic Focus, Craic Eile, Rizedda and Head For Home may track prominently, but most of this field comprises hold-up horses who will rely on late runs. The lack of pace pressure means Je Suis can dictate terms through the early stages, but with 10+ hold-up horses armed with finishing kicks over this stamina-testing 2m6f trip, the race strongly favours closers who can produce sustained runs from the back.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Je Suis sets uncontested fractions and the field bunches turning for home
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace allows closers to conserve energy before unleashing finishing kicks up the hill. Multiple hold-up horses converge late with The Striker Dylan, Charlie's Gift and Anysignofhim best positioned.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent tracker strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Poetic Focus or Rizedda can stalk Je Suis without over-racing
scenarios.body: They get first run on the weakening leader while hold-up horses are still organising their challenges. Superior tactical position beats pure finishing speed over this demanding trip.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front runner survives
scenarios.trigger: If Je Suis maintains strong gallop and hold-up horses leave their runs too late
scenarios.body: The sustainable early pace becomes a winning move as closers find the 2m6f trip stretching their stamina reserves. Je Suis holds on grimly from persistent trackers.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace collapses completely
scenarios.trigger: If Je Suis weakens dramatically and prominent horses also fade
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure stamina test with only the strongest stayers prevailing from impossible positions. Class horses with proven stamina emerge from the pack.

watchPoints.text: Je Suis must be watched for early over-racing if any prominent horses challenge the pace-setting role
Rizedda and Head For Home both show fading patterns in finishes which could be exposed over this trip
The Striker Dylan and Rizedda face fitness concerns after lengthy absences of 210 and 243 days respectively
Charlie's Gift has failed to build on his Sligo breakthrough and may struggle off this higher mark
First-time cheekpieces on Doing It In Style and Queen Kulina could spark improved efforts from disappointing horses

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Mares INH Flat Race

runners_data.name: Getaway Dreams

runners_data.name: Land Me Safe
runners_data.comment: Footstepsinthesand mare, sister to bumper winner, likely type on paper, top yard
runners_data.spotlight: Footstepsinthesand mare; sister to bumper winner Walk On The Beach, half-sister to point winner The Gooner; dam unraced sister to useful 2m4f hurdle/chase winner Go All The Way, half-sister to bumper winner; likely type on paper from top yard.

runners_data.name: Lexenna
runners_data.comment: Gamut mare, dam modest German winner, watch on debut unless market speaks
runners_data.spotlight: Gamut mare; dam 1m3f/1m4f winner (RPR 72), half-sister to German 1m1f/1m2f winner Flick Flack; likely best watched on debut unless the market speaks.

runners_data.name: Online Order
runners_data.comment: Order Of St George mare, dam point winner, hooded for debut, probably best watched
runners_data.spotlight: Order Of St George mare; dam point winner, sister to winners Shantou Rock (smart 2m hurdle/chase) and Ever So Cool (2m hurdle); hooded for debut and probably best watched.

runners_data.name: Saoirses Choice
runners_data.comment: Elusive Pimpernel mare; dam 6f AW winner, yard 0-5 in bumpers last five seasons
runners_data.spotlight: Elusive Pimpernel mare; dam 6f AW winner (RPR 59), half-sister to 1m4f Flat and useful 2m hurdle winner Palace Rock, out of 1m1f/1m2f Flat and 2m hurdle winner; yard 0-5 in bumpers last five seasons; watch.

runners_data.name: Wild Eagle
runners_data.comment: 150-1 and tailed off on debut at Sligo, impossible to fancy after that
runners_data.spotlight: 150-1 and completely tailed off on debut in a 2m2f Sligo bumper 16 days ago; impossible to fancy after that effort.

runners_data.name: Withmylittleeye
runners_data.comment: Solider Of Fortune mare, dam 1m 2yo winner, best watched on debut
runners_data.spotlight: Soldier Of Fortune mare; dam 1m AW 2yo winner (stayed 1m4f), sister to 5f winner Misty Sparkler, half-sister to 1m Listed winner St Moritz, out of US 6f-1m winner; speed on dam side of pedigree; best watched.

runners_data.name: Streamhill
runners_data.comment: Solid efforts in bumpers at Cork and Kilbeggan, leading claims on debut for new yard
runners_data.spotlight: Modest form in both points; definite promise both starts under Rules when beaten around 5l in bumpers at Cork (2m, yielding) and Kilbeggan (16.5f, gd-yld); the form of her Cork run has worked out and she has leading claims on first start for new yard.

runners_data.name: Mistakenforanother
runners_data.comment: Promise on debut at Clonmel, place claims if improves for that initial experience
runners_data.spotlight: Offered something to build on when fourth on debut at Clonmel but was still beaten 18.5l; should improve for that initial experience and place claims if she does.

runners_data.name: Aodha's Arrow
runners_data.comment: Solid effort on debut at Cork, not as good there latest but capable of better
runners_data.spotlight: Form of debut effort at Cork (16.5f, good) has received a couple of boosts but she didn't build on it when beaten 14.5l back there on latest (2m1f, good); capable of better and too soon to write off.

runners_data.name: Brave Lady
runners_data.comment: Promise on debut at Galway last year, out of depth latest, could do better now
runners_data.spotlight: Sent off at just 9-1 on debut at Galway last year and ran a fine race to finish a 3.5l third and the winner has since placed in Listed company; out of depth on first run since in Grade 2 bumper at Aintree in April; could do better returned to calmer waters.
